class.name: HTMLWindow
class.brief_description: The event target for a live document window.
class.description: Every document exposes one window handle through [method HTMLDocumentNode.get_default_view]. Listeners registered on it run first in the capture phase and last in the bubble phase, which makes it the natural place for shortcuts and document-wide handlers. A window becomes invalid when the layout replaces or clears its document.

method.name: get_document
method.description: Returns the document node this window belongs to, or [code]null[/code] when the window is invalid.

members.member: The document node this window belongs to.
